Package com.yetnt.utils.tuple

Record Class Triple<T>

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.yetnt.utils.tuple.Triple<T>
Type Parameters:
T - The type of the elements in the triple.
Record Components:
v1 - The first value
v2 - The second value
v3 - The third value
public record Triple<T>(T v1, T v2, T v3) extends Record
An immutable record representing a tuple of three elements of the same type.

    • stream

      public Stream<T> stream()
      Creates a stream of the 3 elements

      This is functionally identical to calling 

      
     Triple<String> triple = new Triple("hello", "world", "!");
     Stream<String> str = Stream.of(triple.v1(), triple.v2(), triple.v3());

      Returns:
      A stream of the input stuff

    • forEachPair

      public static <T, V> void forEachPair(Triple<T> t1, Triple<V> t2, BiConsumer<T,V> forEachConsumer)
      Applies the given consumer to each positional pair of the two input triples.

      This is if, you were to take v1 of each Triple, and consume them with a BiConsumer, applied to each argument in one call.

      Type Parameters:
      T - The type the first triple holds
      V - The type the second triple holds
      Parameters:
      t1 - The first triple
      t2 - The second triple
      forEachConsumer - The consumer to apply to each positional argument

    • mapPair

      public static <T, U, V> Triple<V> mapPair(Triple<T> t1, Triple<U> t2, BiFunction<T,U,V> mapper)
      Maps each positional pair of the two input triples back into the same position of a new triple.

      This is if you were to take v1 of each Triple, apply the map then save that as v1 of a new triple, applied to each argument in one call. 

      
 Triple<Integer> a = new Triple<>(1, 2, 3);
 Triple<Integer> b = new Triple<>(10, 20, 30);

 Triple<Integer> result =
     TripleUtils.mapPair(a, b, Integer::sum);

 // (11, 22, 33)
      Type Parameters:
      T - The type held by the first triple
      U - The type held by the second triple
      V - The type held by the new returned triple
      Parameters:
      t1 - The first triple
      t2 - The second triple
      mapper - The map to apply to each positional element of the triple
      Returns:
      A new triple

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
      Specified by:
      equals in class Record
      Parameters:
      o - the object with which to compare
      Returns:
      true if this object is the same as the o argument; false otherwise.
